question: Who was the captain of the U-19 Indian cricket team in the World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yash Dhull.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yash Dhull **was the **captain **of the **U-19 Indian cricket team** in **World Cup 2022.**
 
• He led the team to the **quarterfinals** of the tournament.
 
• Yash Dhull is a promising young cricketer from** Haryana** who has been making waves in the domestic cricket.
 
• He is a **right-handed middle-order batsman** and a handy off-spinner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vasu Vats, and Manav Parakh are** not known names** in Indian cricket and have not represented the country at any level.
 
• Yash Dhull was selected as the captain of the U-19 Indian cricket team in the **World Cup 2022 **based on his leadership skills and cricketing abilities.
 
• The U-19 Indian cricket team in World Cup 2022 had some talented players like** Ravi Bishnoi, Divyansh Saxena, and Arjun Azad **who impressed with their performances.
 
• The group leads all Under-19 national teams in ODI wins % and has won** five** Under-19 World Cups.
 
• The group has placed** third three times** and won the Under-19 World Cup** five times. **
